title: DCP Multi-Copy Distinct-Header Cyclic-Swap and Schur-Weyl Bipartite Even-Flip Interference Bridge
claims: Every r-cycle permutation trace Tr(C_r (rho_1 tensor ... tensor rho_r)) expands purely over even-sized alternating subsets 2m <= 2*floor(r/2) of balanced header differences sum_{l=1}^m (theta_{j_l} - theta_{k_l}) and is strictly invariant under s -> -s.

At r=3 distinct headers, Tr(Pi_{Sym^3}(rho_1 tensor rho_2 tensor rho_3)) = 1/2 + (1/6)*sum_{j<k} gamma_j*gamma_k*cos(theta_j - theta_k) reduces strictly to 2-body pairwise differences with zero 3-body sum harmonic.
